title: Give the Mark III its day: the learn setting in the bot brain, and Robot Mk III in the shop
tier_reason: Gameplay code behind both suites; git reverts it. The price is ruled: 800 gold (Q-96).
ask: Per docs/design/06: a 'learn' config branch in BotBrain.step that builds the observation, samples the policy, executes one step or one water-here through the gateway, wakes once a second (extra.wake = tick + SimClock.RATE), and parks when its meter is 0; a bot_mk3 catalogue row (program 'policy', configs [], default_config 'learn') added to ORDER; the machine panel showing days practised and yesterday's score in numbers (Q-97's floor). Panel numbers are the ruled v1 night surface (Q-97). Price 800 gold (Q-96).
first_action: Add CONFIG_LEARN to bot_brain.gd and the _learn() branch after the mark-1's page check; add the bot_mk3 row to systems/machine_defs.gd and to ORDER; extend test_mark_one_robot's catalogue assertions with the third row; then the panel numbers.
source_message: CEO, 2026-09-09, chief of staff session: v0.2.1 is the Mark III, the robot that learns by reinforcement (P-14).
result: Landed on main (merged from an Opus worker's worktree, commit ca455b3): CONFIG_LEARN and the _learn branch in bot_brain.gd, deploy writing the learned keys, on_result scoring a wet tile, the learn arm of on_new_day, Policy.salt_of, the bot_mk3 row and ORDER entry (icon: the Mk II sheet until WI-6). test_learning_robot_day, 56 assertions, including the two-day replay chapter and save/restore weight equality. Unit 2349 passed, integration 650 passed, robot session passed, gateway check passed. The panel numbers (Q-97's floor) are still to do and stay with this seat. Chief of staff verified: ran both suites on main after the merge. Panel landed later the same day (commit d6b985f merged): a readout row for a Mark III — a crescent with days, the HUD's own can glyph with yesterday's count — above Pick up; the panel previously could not show a policy-program machine at all. Integration suite 671 passed with 21 new assertions. Scorecard landed 2026-09-10 (commit a669d42 merged): ui/bot_scorecard.gd draws the last fourteen days from extra['history'] (thirty closed days, eight floats each, JSON-plain, replayed and saved), one line per rewarded action with its pip as the legend, today as an unfinished column; the Mark III's panel widens to 380 and keeps Pick up and the close target. Unit 2435, integration 685, robot session and gateway green.

follow_ups.title: Show days practised and yesterday's score on the machine panel
follow_ups.first_action: Add a two-number row to the machine panel for a bot whose config is 'learn': days practised and yesterday's score, read from the learned keys bot_brain.gd writes on_new_day. Numbers only — Q-97 ruled that as the v1 night surface floor.
follow_ups.why: It was in the ask and is the ruled floor for the night surface; without it the player who spent 800 gold cannot see the bot learning.

follow_ups.title: Draw the Mark III its own shop and world sprite
follow_ups.first_action: Take assets/sprites/generated/bot_mk3.png (already generated, currently untracked) through palette-lock and post-processing into the atlas, record provenance in CREDITS.md, and point the bot_mk3 catalogue row at it instead of the Mk II sheet.
follow_ups.why: The shop currently sells the Mark III wearing the Mark II's art, so the purchase reads as a duplicate of a bot the player owns.

follow_ups.title: Keep the Mark III out of the next release until its panel and sprite land
follow_ups.first_action: Mark bot_mk3 below the cut line for the next player-facing release, with the panel-numbers story and the sprite story as its two blockers; move it above the line when both are done.
follow_ups.why: The code is green but the two player-visible pieces are not, and a tag ships whatever is on main.

recommend.question: Does the Mark III go out to players in the next release as it stands, or wait for its panel numbers and its own sprite?
recommend.answer: Accept the code onto main and hold the Mark III out of the next release until the panel numbers and the sprite land.
recommend.why: A learning bot whose learning you cannot see, wearing another bot's face, teaches the player the wrong thing about what 800 gold bought.
recommend.instead: Ship it now and treat the numbers and sprite as a fast follow — reasonable if he wants the Mark III in front of players sooner and is willing to have its first impression be a mystery box.
